Metric operation: average; row policy: multiple

Grounding:
- school names -> csv/frpm.csv.School Name
- Do not use db/satscores.db.satscores.sname: Secondary source for school names; frpm.csv is the authoritative source for school metadata including funding types.
- funding types -> csv/frpm.csv.Charter Funding Type
- Riverside-related school districts -> csv/frpm.csv.District Name

- Do not use db/satscores.db.satscores.dname: Redundant if joining via frpm.csv; frpm.csv is the row source.
- average SAT math score -> db/satscores.db.satscores.AvgScrMath
- Do not use db/satscores.db.satscores.AvgScrRead: Wrong subject (Reading).
- Do not use db/satscores.db.satscores.AvgScrWrite: Wrong subject (Writing).
- join keys -> csv/frpm.csv.CDSCode, db/satscores.db.satscores.cds

Join path:
- csv/frpm.csv.CDSCode => db/satscores.db.satscores.cds

Answer contract:
- Submit columns exactly as: School Name, Funding Type
- Use source field: School Name <- csv/frpm.csv.School Name
- Use source field: Funding Type <- csv/frpm.csv.Charter Funding Type
- Driving row source: csv/frpm.csv
- Filters: csv/frpm.csv.District Name LIKE '%Riverside%'
- Group by: csv/frpm.csv.District Name
- Metric fields: db/satscores.db.satscores.AvgScrMath
- Enrichment fields: csv/frpm.csv.CDSCode
- Join policy: inner
- Output grain: school
- Distinct policy: preserve

Use this handoff as trusted guidance; call tools to compute the requested result.
